name: Being A Good Mother
overview: Scripture reveals that being a good mother is rooted in God's design, as He created male and female in His own image to complement one another (Genesis 1:27; 2:20). Honoring parents is commanded by God and brings blessings, emphasizing the sacred role of mothers in family life (Exodus 20:12). Children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord, highlighting the precious responsibility entrusted to mothers (Psalms 127:3). Loving God wholeheartedly (Deuteronomy 6:5) and seeking wisdom and favor (Proverbs 3:4) are foundational to fulfilling this God-ordained role with grace and understanding.
